value.text: The image displays an outdoor chalkboard menu mounted on a brick wall, likely belonging to The Garden Cafe & Hove as indicated by the website address at the top center. It is divided into five distinct sections: "Opening Hours," "Breakfast," "Sandwiches," "Quiche," and "Hot Drinks." Each section lists specific dishes with ingredients written in white chalk, such as "Smashed Avocado on Asper" for breakfast or "Tuna Mackerel & Chilli" for sandwiches. The menu also features a note about organic ingredients and recyclable packaging at the bottom.
